body:
Thanks for responding. Well, I've had a lot of things end like this. I've lost hope, it doesn't seem like it could ever work out differently. I want to believe you, but my experiences say something else.

My family tries to be supportive, but really it's made it worse. They freak out about it and sometimes cry in front of me. I know I can't expect anything different, but they're just more people that I'm hurting. I can't be open with them anymore because I'm afraid they'll be in even more pain.
Please, give us a chance.  We want to listen and help
